an10.85:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ mahācundo cetīsu viharati sahajātiyaṃ.
an10.85:1.2: tatra kho āyasmā mahācundo bhikkhu āmantesi
an10.85:1.4: āvusoti kho te bhikkhu āyasmato mahācundassa paccassosuṃ.
an10.85:2.1: idhāvuso bhikkhu katthi hoti vikatthi adhigamesu
an10.85:2.2: “ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmipi vuṭṭhahāmipi. ahaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmipi vuṭṭhahāmipi. ahaṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmipi vuṭṭhahāmipi. ahaṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmipi vuṭṭhahāmipi. ahaṃ ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samāpajjāmipi vuṭṭhahāmipi. ahaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samāpajjāmipi vuṭṭhahāmipi. ahaṃ ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjāmipi vuṭṭhahāmipi. ahaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjāmipi vuṭṭhahāmipi. ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjāmipi vuṭṭhahāmipī”ti.
an10.85:3.1: tamenaṃ tathāgato vā tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo samanuyuñjati samanugāhati samanubhāsati.
an10.85:3.2: so tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā jhāyinā samāpattikusalena paracittakusalena paracittapariyāyakusalena samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno irīṇaṃ āpajjati vipinaṃ āpajjati anayaṃ āpajjati byasanaṃ āpajjati anayabyasanaṃ āpajjati.
an10.85:4.1: tamenaṃ tathāgato vā tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manasikaroti,
an10.85:4.2: kinnu kho ayamāyasmā katthi hoti vikatthi adhigamesu
an10.85:5.1: tamenaṃ tathāgato vā tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti.
an10.85:6.1: dīgharattaṃ kho pana ayamāyasmā, khaṇḍakārī chiddakārī sabalakārī kammāsakārī na santatakārī na sannatavuttī sīlesu
an10.85:6.3: dussīlyaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
an10.85:7.2: assaddhiyaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
an10.85:8.2: appasaccaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
an10.85:9.2: dovacassatā kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
an10.85:10.2: pāpamittā kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
an10.85:11.2: kosajjaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
an10.85:12.2: muṭṭhasaccaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
an10.85:13.2: kohaññaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
an10.85:14.2: dubbharatā kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
an10.85:15.2: duppaññatā kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
an10.85:16.1: seyyathāpi āvuso sahāyako sahāyakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya:
an10.85:16.2: yadā te samma dhanena dhanakaraṇīyaṃ assa, yācissasi maṃ dhanaṃ, dassāmi te dhananti.
an10.85:16.3: so kismicideva dhanakaraṇīye samuppanne sahāyako sahāyakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya: “attho me samma dhanena, dehi me dhananti”.
an10.85:16.5: “tena hi samma idha khanāhī”ti. so tatra khananto nādhigaccheyya,
an10.85:16.7: “alikaṃ maṃ samma avaca, tucchakaṃ maṃ samma avaca “idha khanāhī”ti.
an10.85:16.9: “nāhaṃ taṃ samma alikaṃ avacaṃ, tucchakaṃ avacaṃ, tena hi samma idha khanāhī”ti.
an10.85:16.12: “alikaṃ maṃ samma avaca, tucchakaṃ maṃ samma avaca ‘idha khanāhī’ti. so evaṃ vadeyya “nāhaṃ taṃ samma alikaṃ avacaṃ, na tucchakaṃ avacaṃ, tena hi samma idha khanāhīti. so tatrapi khananto nādhigaccheyya, so evaṃ vadeyya “alikaṃ maṃ samma avaca, tucchakaṃ maṃ samma avaca ‘idha khanāhī’ti.
an10.85:16.14: “nāhaṃ taṃ samma alikaṃ avacaṃ, tucchakaṃ avacaṃ, tena hi samma idha khanāhī”ti.
an10.85:16.17: “alikaṃ maṃ samma avaca, tucchakaṃ maṃ samma avaca ‘idha khanāhī”ti.
an10.85:16.19: “nāhaṃ taṃ samma alikaṃ avacaṃ, tucchakaṃ avacaṃ, api ca ahameva ummādaṃ pāpuṇiṃ cetaso vipariyāya”nti.
an10.85:17.1: evameva kho āvuso bhikkhu katthī vikatthi adhigamesu
